description: Returns the payment action and the EIP-712 typedData to sign for a plan (exact price, WakeTrades receiver): usdSend from your free perps USDC, or sendAsset from your spot USDC when the perps balance is short (unified account). The free trial must have started. Before signing, check typedData (not only action): primaryType HyperliquidTransaction:UsdSend or HyperliquidTransaction:SendAsset, message.destination = receiver and message.amount = your plan's price, both from GET https://waketrades.com/api/v1/subscription; never sign a Withdraw.
name: prepare_payment
title: Prepare a plan payment
